s: Dine shittup beerub ubo y' seipim: haddar bebet shaar, ap al pi sheyyesh lo d' mechitztzot, kevan sherabbim oberim derek sham lebattehem — en alayv torat bayit ella torat chatzer, veen tzarik leareb im shear habbattim. Veken haddar beaksadra umirpeset shebbechatzer eno oser al bene hechatzer, sheenan chashubot dira. Veken sukkat hechag bechag enah chashuba dira leesor. Abal haddar bebet hatteben, bebet habbaqar, bebet haotzar, bebet haetzim — oser ad sheyyeareb, lepi sheruyim ladur bahem vachashubim dira, ap al pi sheasuyim miqqanim vekayyotze bahem:

Baal habbayit sheyyesh lo harbeh battim bachatzero, vehiskiran laacherim o shehishilam (lizman, beinyan sheeno yakol lesalleqam tok hazzeman beal korcham) — hare hem oserim alayv bechatzer keillu hayu battim shellahem, ad sheyyearebu. Veken asur letaltel mibbeto lebattehem ad sheyyearebu. Veim yesh lo bekol echad mehem debarim sheenam nittalim beshabbat mechamat issur, sheasur letaltelam apillu letzorek gupam o meqomam, kevan shello silleq atzmo mibbattim ellu mikkol vakol ella yesh lo bahem tepisat yad — naasa keillu dar bahem, veen haddarim oserim alayv, lepi shennaasu kullam keorechim etzlo. Ulepikak gam hem muttarim lehotzi mibbattehem lechatzer, ap al pi shello natenu erub, kemo shemmuttarim orechim shemmitorchim bebeto lehotzi mibbeto lechatzer beli sheyyearebu immo. Abal im en lo bahem ella debarim shemmuttar letaltel letzorek gupam o meqomam — en zo chashuba tepisat yad, kevan sheyyakol lehotziam mishsham kesheyyitztarek lahem (o limqomam). Veyesh omerim sheim enan nittalin mechamat kobdan, chashubin tepisat yad ap al pi shemmuttarim betiltul (veyesh lehachamir bezeh). Veen tepisat yad moelet ella bebattim shehem shello, ben shehem qenuyim lo ben shehem sekurim o sheulim etzlo vechazar vehiskiram o hishilam laacherim. Abal mi sheyyesh lo tepisat yad bebayit sheeno lo qanuy velo sakur velo shaul — en zeh moil kelum, veoser alayv bechatzer veken letaltel mibbeto lebetam:

Yesh omerim sheen tepisat yad moelet ella kesheen immahem diyyurin acherim bechatzer, veaz en tzarik leareb kelal benehem, o apillu yesh diyyurim bechatzer ella sheotan diyyurim mebiim eruban umannichin oto bebeto shel baal habbayit zeh sheyyesh lo tepisat yad, o beechad mibbattim ellu sheyyesh lo bahem tepisat yad, veaz en kol battim ellu tzerikim litten kelal laerub pat, lepi shekkol battim ellu hem kebayit echad, ubayit shehaerub munnach bo en tzarik litten et happat. Abal im haerub munnach beechad mibbatte haddiyyurin — hare kol habbattim ellu tzerikim kol echad litten pat laerub, shemmittok shebbattim ellu huzqequ leerub al kol panim bishbil bayit sheddar bo baal habbayit, tzerikim gam hem litten bishbil battehem, ap al pi sheyyesh lebaal habbayit bahem tepisat yad. Vahare dino immahem kedin achim hamqabbelim peras meabihem sheyyitbaer:

Echad shessakar bira min hannokri vedar bah im chabero, zeh becheder zeh vezeh becheder zeh, veyesh lehassoker tepisat yad becheder chabero, im mittechillat hassekirut shessekarah min hannokri hiskimu ladur yachad uledaat ken sekarah min hannokri, ap al pi shehu lebaddo sekarah min hannokri — hare chabero shuttap immo bah veeno yakol lesalleqo kol zeman meshek hassekirut min hannokri, shekkevan shelledaat ken sekarah min hannokri, kede sheyyaduru beyachad — hare naasa hu shaliach lachabero liskor baado min hannokri, ulepikak en tepisat yad moelet lo beshel chabero, kevan sheeno shello. Abal im mittechillat hassekirut sekarah leatzmo, veachar kak nimlak vehiskir lachabero — moil lo tepisat yad beshel chabero:

Chamesh chaburot sheshshabetu bitraqlin vechillequhu bimchitztzot lachamishsha chadarim, vekol echad mehem patuach lechatzer — im hammechitztzot maggiot lattiqra, o betok g' tepachim samuk lattiqra, hare kol echad veechad cheder bipne atzmo, apillu hen mechitztzot aray kegon shel yeriot, utzerikot kol echad veechad mehachaburot litten eruban. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyesh od diyyurin bechatzer, veerub kol hechatzer mannichin oto beechad middiyyurin hahem o bechatzer acheret sheereba im zo, shemmittok shetteraqlin zeh huzqaq laerub mechamat haddiyyurin — tzerika kol chabura litten erub. Abal im diyyurin hahem natenu eruban bezeh hatteraqlin, enam tzerikim litten erub kelal, shekkullam darim bebayit zeh, ubayit shemmannichin bo haerub eno tzarik litten pat lehaerub. Veap shetteraqlin zeh muchlaq bimchitztzot leHashem chadarim, vehaerub hu beechad mehem — en bekak kelum, hoil veenan ella mechitztzot aray. Veken im en diyyurin acherim kelal bechatzer en tzarik erub kelal, sheenan oserim kelal zeh al zeh, hoil vekullam bebayit echad sheeno muchlaq ella bimchitztzot aray. Chillequhu bimchitztzot sheenan maggiot lattiqra — apillu im yesh diyyurin bechatzer veerub kol hechatzer mannichim beechad middiyyurin hahem, en tzerikim kol hachaburot ella litten erub echad keillu en benehen mechitztzot kelal. Veim miqtzatan asu mechitztzot hammaggiot lattiqra umiqtzatan lo asu — otan sheasu hem mechullaqim, veotan shello asu hen kimshuttapin. Vekol zeh kesheasu mechitztzot aray lepi shaa. Abal im shabetu bachadarim vaaliyyot mammash, vehem petuchim lechatzer — oserim zeh al zeh apillu en diyyurin acherim bechatzer. Utzerikot kol chabura vachabura litten erub apillu mannichin haerub bezeh hatteraqlin. Vekol zeh keshekkullam petuchim lechatzer. Abal im en patuach lechatzer ella hachitzon bilbad, vekullam oberim derek alayv, apillu hem chadarim mammash — en tzarik litten erub ella shenayim happenimiyyim, shehem bilbaddam chashubim dirot veoserim bechatzer zeh al zeh veken letaltel mizzeh lezeh, abal kol haacherim chashubim kebet shaar lahem, kemo sheyyitbaer. Vekol zeh keshekkullam shavin bitraqlin zeh. Abal baal habbayit sheyyesh lo melammed o soper bebeto, veken talmidim hallomedim bipne harab vedarim bebeto, ap al pi sheyyesh lekol echad cheder meyuchad patuach lechatzer vegam lirshut harabbim, veokel veyashen bechadro — en tzarik leareb bechatzer kelal, mippene sheen oserim kelal, lo bechatzer velo letaltel mechadrehem labbayit o mecheder lecheder, apillu en lo bahem tepisat yad, lepi sheeno mashil lahem reshuto leesor alayv velo leesor zeh al zeh, vahare yakol lesalleqam bekol et. Abal im hachadarim qenuyim lahem o sekurim (o sheulim beinyan sheeno yakol lesalleqam tok zeman sheilatam — en lomar sheeno mashil lahem reshuto leesor alayv, kevan shekkebar hishil lahem veen beyado lesalleqam, ubeal korcho hem) oserim alayv, ella im ken yesh lo bahem tepisat yad. Vaapillu hem mishtammeshim baapiyya ubishshul bebayit gadol shel baal habbayit — en zeh moil kelum, kevan sheokelim bechadrehem, ella im ken talmidim hamqabbelim peras merabban kemo sheyyitbaer:

Iqqar dirat haadam hi meqom akilat pat, velo meqom hashshena velina. Lepikak anshe hechatzer shehayu kullam okelim bebayit echad beshabbat, ap al pi shekkol echad okel mishshello al shulchan bipne atzmo, veyesh lekol echad cheder bipne atzmo bechatzer sheddar sham kol hayyom vekol hallayla — enam tzerikim erub, mippene shehem keanshe bayit echad veenan oserim zeh al zeh. Veken im hutzreku laasot erub im chatzer acher — erub echad lekullam upat echad bilbad molikin leoto maqom shehem meorbin immo, veezeh mehem sheyyirtzeh yitten happat, vaapillu bene beto shel baal habbayit yekolin litten happat mishshellahem. Veim haya haerub ba etzlam — en tzarik litten pat kelal, kemo habbayit shemmannichim bo haerub sheen tzarik litten happat, shekkol ellu habbattim kebayit echad hem chashubim, kevan sheakilat baalehem hi bebayit echad beli mechitztza mapseqet benehem. Vaapillu im lipamim poresin vilon lipnehem litzniut — eno chashub mechitztza lachaloq benehem, apillu im maggia lattiqra, hoil veeno parus sham tamid kol zeman shehem babbayit, ella kesherotzin laasot sham debar tzeniut poresin oto veachar kak mesalleqin oto. Mah sheen ken bachaburot sheshshabetu bitraqlin, shehayriot shepparesu benehen hen perusot sham kol zeman shebitatan sham. Umi sheyyesh lo shette battim bishte chatzerot, beachat hu okel ubashsheniyya hu dar kol hayyom vekol hallayla — hare zeh oser beotah sheokel im okel sham beshabbat, vetzarik leareb immahem. Abal bashsheniyya eno oser veen tzarik leareb umuttar lehishtammesh sham beshabbat, lepi shennaaseh sham keoreach etzlam:

Haachim sheyyesh lahem battim bachatzar abihem umeqabbelim peras meabihem veokelim bebattehem, ben shehapperas hu lechem ben shehu maot liqnot bo lechem, im yesh od diyyurim bechatzer umannichim erub kol hechatzer beechad middiyyurin hahem — tzerikim haachim im abihem litten kol echad erubo, shemmittok shebbattim ellu shel haab ubanayv huzqequ leerub, tzerikim litten kol echad veechad. Abal im en immahem diyyurin bechatzer, en tzarik erub kelal, sheenan oserim zeh al zeh, hoil veokelim peras abihem — naasu kibne beto. O apillu yesh immahem diyyurin, ella shemmannichim haerub beechad mibbattim ellu shel haachim o bebet abihem — enan tzerikin leareb kelal, lepi shekkullam kebayit echad shemmannichim bo haerub, sheen tzarik litten et happat. Veken benashim hamqabbelot peras mibbaalehen, ubaabadim hamqabbelim peras meadonehem, ubetalmidim hamqabbelim peras merabban:

Asara battim zeh lipnim mizzeh, veen patuach mehem lechatzer ella hachitzon bilbad, vekullam oberim mizzeh lezeh veyotzein derek hachitzon lechatzer — shenayim happenimim lebaddam tzerikim litten erub, shehem lebaddam torat bayit alehem, veoserim bechatzer veken letaltel mizzeh lezeh veken mehem lebattim shellipnehem velechatzer. Abal shear habbattim shellipnehem — torat chatzer alehem, lepi shekkol echad mehem hu bet shaar lehappenimi mimmennu, veim ken bayit hashshelishi mehappenim hu bet shaar leb' happenimim, veniqra bet shaar shel rabbim, veeno chashub dira kevan sherabbim oberim alayv. Abal bayit hashsheni eno bet shaar ella lebayit echad happenimi mimmennu, ubet shaar shel bayit echad eno mitbattel mittorat bayit:

Hammitareach bechatzer, apillu nitarach bebayit bipne atzmo veokel veyashen sham bebeto, im lo nitarach derek qeba ella lishloshim yom o pachot — eno oser al bene hechatzer, vehu vahem muttarim letaltel bechatzer, ben mibbeto ben mibbattehem. Vaapillu im haorechim rabbim ubaal habbayit echad — kullam tepelim etzlo venaasim keanshe beto, apillu im habbattim shemmitorchim bahem enam shello ella shel nokrim o shel yisreelim sheenam darim sham. Veyesh omerim shehaoreach shemmitareach bebayit o cheder bipne atzmo eno tapel lebaal habbayit lihyot keanshe beto, ella shekkol shello nitarach bederek qeba en lo cheleq bechatzer, veeno oser al baal habbayit letaltel mibbeto lachatzero. Abal letaltel mibbet haoreach lechatzer — asur ben lo ben lebaal habbayit, shekkevan shehiskiro lo bayit zeh leezeh zeman, sekirut leyomo mimkar hu vahare zeh bayit shello, ukeshemmotzi mishsham lachatzar baal habbayit, hare zeh kemotzi mereshut lirshut (vehu haddin im hishiluhu lo beinyan sheenam yekolim lesalleqo tok meshek zeman sheelato. Veeno domeh leanshe chatzer sheshshakach echad mehem velo ereb, shekkeshemmebattel lahem reshut beto muttar gam hu lehotzi mibbeto lechatzer mippene shennaaseh etzlam keoreach, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"p, lepi shehambattel silleq atzmo mereshut beto unetano lahem. Mah sheen ken oreach shello bittel velo silleq atzmo, ubene hechatzer gam ken enam yekolim lesalleqo — hare reshut beto meyuchedet lo ureshut chatzer meyuchedet lahem, veasur lehotzi mereshut zo lezo ad sheyyearebu):

Abal leachar sheloshim yom oser al bene hechatzer im hu beinyan sheenam yekolim lesalleqo tok meshek zeman sekiruto o sheelato. Umikkol maqom apillu im qobea leyoter mishsheloshim yom, eno oser ad leachar sheloshim yom, abal lo tok sheloshim, apillu im ragil labo lekan veliqboa leolam leyoter mishsheloshim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beoreach yisrael, abal aksenay nokri haragil liqboa — oser miyyad, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"d. Veyesh omerim sheggam yisrael haragil liqboa oser miyyad. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel. Vekol zeh kesheyyesh baal habbayit echad qabua bechatzer, sheaz haorechim shebbebattim acherim shebbechatzer zo betelim etzlo. Abal orechim lebaddam beyachad oserim zeh al zeh miyyad im yesh lekol echad cheder meyuchad laakila. Veim yesh nokri dar bechatzer, tzerikim liskor mimmennu reshuto, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"b. Vekol zeh bemaqom sheen sham erube chatzerot shel rabbim. Abal bemaqom shehaqqahal meorbim erube chatzerot bitchillat shana lekol hashshana, en haorechim hammittosepim sham oserim alehem velo zeh al zeh, mippene shelleb bet din matneh alehem sheyyehe lahem cheleq baerub, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"v:
